description: Search the ByJG open source documentation and return the most relevant passages, each with its public URL. Combines semantic and keyword matching, so both natural-language questions ('how do I map a table to a class') and exact symbol names ('TableAttribute') work. Optionally narrow to a category (php, devops, js, ai, helm) or a project (micro-orm, restserver, docker-easy-haproxy, ...).

category.description: Restrict to one category: php, devops, js, ai or helm.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Maximum passages to return; 0 uses the server default. Capped by the server.
limit.title: Limit

project.description: Restrict to one project, as named by list_projects (e.g. micro-orm).
project.title: Project

query.description: A natural-language question or an exact symbol name.
query.title: Query

name: search_docs
title: Search ByJG documentation
